app_fee.value: The application fee is EUR 30 for each doctoral programme you apply to. It is paid online and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable fee of € 30.00 must be paid for each doctoral program

fee_waiver.value: The 42nd-cycle call for applications mentions no waiver of the application fee.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional. If you upload a score, it earns 2 to 6 points in the qualifications assessment.
gre_general.quote: The applicant may upload the following optional documents via the Apply portal | m) GRE score (obtained within the last 5 years)

toefl_min.value: The TOEFL score table is split in the source PDF, so no minimum is used.

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is an overall 5.5, which is the level the university accepts for the B2 English requirement.

english_waiver.value: A degree taught entirely in English in India and recognised by the Italian Ministry (MUR) is exempt from the English test. You must upload an official letter from your institution confirming that the course was entirely in English.
english_waiver.quote: obtained entirely in English at a high school or university located in the countries listed in the table below | official documentation from the institution where the program was completed must be uploaded, certifying that the program was conducted entirely in English

also.quote: A degree recognized by the Ministry of Education, Universities, and Research as equivalent to a high school diploma or higher university degree

notes: Source: 42nd-cycle call for applications (Rectoral Decree 320/2026, amended by 350/2026), plus the call-for-applications page.
